title: Measure false rejection from a ten-case screen
hypothesis: A thirty-case screen preserves beneficial frozen edits that a ten-case screen rejects through sampling ties.

prediction.against: Ten-case screening of the same frozen, identically refitted parent-child pair
prediction.rationale: Measure independently evaluated success of the controller selected by each screen size; two percentage points would justify examining this bottleneck. Unlike R-003, this changes sample size without adaptive evolution or generation-wise rotation. Remote spend requires per-idea approval.

protocol.command: python scripts/compare_child_vs_parent.py --run logs/two_lane_search --research-protocol nested-screen --child gen0_cand5_a0 --screen-seed 2800 --heldout-seed 2801 2805 --fit-seed 2802 --replay-seed 2803 --probe-seed 2804 --out-dir logs/research/nested_screen_s2800
code_changes: scripts/compare_child_vs_parent.py (--research-protocol nested-screen: frozen gen0_cand5_a0 vs simple_damped_push, identical refit, probe s2804 x10, screen s2800 x30, confirmation s2801 x100, 1000 ten-case replays seeded 2803; manifests built into the out dir)

falsified_by: An upper paired 95% confidence bound below +0.02 refutes the predicted benefit; an interval including zero leaves the directional advantage inconclusive. Support requires a gain of at least +0.02 and a lower bound above zero.

controls.note: control is ten-case screening of the same refitted pair; the metric is already full-screen minus ten-case selection

result.notes: Frozen pair gen0_cand5_a0 (geometry-scope mutation) vs simple_damped_push, both refitted with fit seed 2802 (budget 1000, checkpoints 0/500/1000 on a fresh 10-case probe s2804; both selected step {'child': 1000, 'parent': 1000}). 30-case screen (s2800): child 1.000, parent 0.867; full screen accepts. Ten-case replays (1000, seed 2803) accept 96.0%; the 40 rejections are all tied success with lower or equal progress, none lower success. Selected-controller paired difference over 100 confirmation placements (s2801+s2805): +0.0044 [+0.0019, +0.0069]; upper bound below the predicted +0.02. Secondary (decisive per the advisor): refitted child minus parent on confirmation +0.110 [+0.048, +0.172], 11/0/89, replicating R-005's +0.14 for this pair under a different fit seed and fresh cases. Deviation: an MT1 pool seed gives 50 placements, so the 100-case confirmation used pool seeds 2801 and 2805 (2805 added and reserved before the run). Replays are conditional on one fitted pair and one screen pool, not replicates. 320 episodes, 0 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: Full-screen minus ten-case selected-controller success is +0.0044 [+0.0019, +0.0069] over 100 confirmation placements; the upper bound is below the predicted +0.02, which the predeclared falsifier names as refuting. The ten-case screen accepted the beneficial child in 96% of replays (rejections only on tied success), so screen sampling is not what blocks good edits for this pair. Separately, the refitted geometry-scope child beats its parent by +0.110 [+0.048, +0.172], 11/0/89, replicating R-005: this LLM mutation is genuinely beneficial and a 10-case screen keeps it. The repair failures in Stage F/R-006 are therefore about edit quality, not screen size.
verdicts.next_experiment: Treat gen0_cand5_a0 (geometry-scope damped push) as a validated fittable structure; consider admitting it to the seed bank under the qualification rule, and ask why geometry-scope edits work when correction-LLM repairs do not.

verdicts.reasoning: Against the measured ten-case screening control, thirty-case selection produced paired_success_difference +0.0044, with paired 95% interval [+0.0019, +0.0069] [logs/research/nested_screen_s2800/summary.json]. The upper bound is below the predicted +0.02 increase, refuting the prespecified magnitude despite a positive conditional difference [logs/research/nested_screen_s2800/summary.json]. Ten-case replays accepted the child 96% of the time; all 40 rejections involved tied success and lower or equal progress, rather than lower success [logs/research/nested_screen_s2800/summary.json]. The child independently outperformed its parent by +0.11 [+0.0476, +0.1724], but that child-parent advantage does not establish the predicted screen-size benefit [logs/research/nested_screen_s2800/summary.json]. These replay results are conditional on the fitted pair and screen pool, not independent replications across fitting and screening draws [logs/research/nested_screen_s2800/summary.json].
